record.notes: Adopted by the National Assembly on 21 October 2025 and promulgated on 31 October 2025. In force on the 31st day after promulgation (1 December 2025); section 3(2) and section 10 on the AI regulatory sandbox took effect on 2 August 2026. Government Decree 344/2025 (X. 31.) (HU-02) designates the authorities and sets the detailed rules on their procedures and on fines. Until the end of the term set in Government Resolution 1028/2025 (II. 24.), the Government Commissioner for AI chairs the AI Council. The Commission's list of single points of contact (last updated 7 September 2026) showed no entry for Hungary.

verification.note: Recheck of 17 Oct 2026: re-read the act on the National Legislation Database (njt.jog.gov.hu, ELI TV/2025/75, stored 11 Oct 2026, showing the text in force from 2 August 2026). It confirms the title, adoption by the National Assembly on 21 October 2025, promulgation on 31 October 2025, the entry-into-force rules, the authorities, the AI Council and its chair, the sandbox and the fine provision, and refers to Government Decree 344/2025 for the designations. The other file stored earlier (document-1.pdf) is the database's accessibility statement. Stored in this run: the Commission's list of AI Act single points of contact (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu), which shows no entry for Hungary. The bill on parlament.hu (T/12632) could not be stored: the site answered with a CAPTCHA page, so the bill number was removed from the notes. judgment.status_reasoning: Section 12(1): in force on the 31st day after promulgation; promulgated on 31 October 2025, so the 31st day is 1 December 2025. Section 12(2): section 3(2) and section 10 from 2 August 2026, which has passed (17 October 2026). The njt page shows the text in force from 2 August 2026 and no repeal; 'In force' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: A national law implementing the EU AI Act and creating its institutions; in scope with no note.
judgment.date_reasoning: date_published stays the promulgation date (31 October 2025), as published; adoption on 21 October 2025 is in the notes.
